statement: Intel Foundry revenue rose 31% year-over-year to $5.8 billion and gross margin improved to 40.4% GAAP from 27.5% a year earlier.
why: A second viable leading-edge foundry and packaging source would ease the single biggest chokepoint on accelerator manufacturing.

impact.mechanism: Growing foundry revenue and improving margin indicate additional wafer and advanced-packaging capacity coming online outside the dominant supplier.

evidence.excerpt: Intel Foundry revenue rose 31% to $5.8 billion.
Gross margin was 40.4% GAAP / 41.8% non-GAAP (versus 27.5% GAAP prior year).
